item.text: I’m gathering program-and-implementation evidence for 8B, with the key question being what Sharif actually tried to do in 2022 and what his team delivered under IMF/flood pressure. I’ll keep the dossier centered on explicit goals, cabinet choices, budget actions, and outcome direction, not on moral judgments.
